title: Alphabet Sheds Half a Trillion in Market Value in Stock's Worst Day Ever
summary: Alphabet shares suffered their steepest one-day drop on record after quarterly results, erasing roughly half a trillion dollars of market value. Investor discontent centered on slowing search revenue growth (12%, from 17% a quarter earlier) and negative free cash flow of about $9.1 billion, even as Google Cloud revenue grew 103%. The reaction highlights tensions in Alphabet's transition from search engine to AI hyperscaler.

title: Alphabet Still Has the Ingredients to Win in an AI Pullback
summary: A WSJ analysis argues that Alphabet is no longer loved by investors despite a broad set of advantages across cloud, chips, models and distribution. It frames the company as relatively well positioned if enthusiasm for AI spending cools.

title: Amazon Earnings Miss Wall Street Estimates Despite Highest Cloud Growth in Five Years
summary: Amazon reported third-quarter results in which AWS revenue came in above expectations and cloud growth hit its fastest pace in five years, with net profit topping $20 billion. Overall earnings nonetheless missed Wall Street estimates.

title: Canada to Take Equity Stake in AI Firm Cohere
summary: Canada's government will take an equity stake in Cohere, committing up to $1.6 billion as the company raises about $7 billion at a reported $35.7 billion valuation. Nvidia, Germany's Schwarz Group and telecom firm BCE are among those with commitments to the round.

title: AI Is Almost the Easy Part. Everything Else Is Hard
summary: Microsoft and Google earnings show AI demand outrunning capacity, with Google Cloud up 103% and Azure up 48%, but the harder challenges are business-model and operating-model disruption. Google's search growth slowed as AI Mode monetizes at lower rates, ServiceNow fell 14% on AI fears, and Microsoft has offered buyouts to about 60,000 employees while rebuilding how work gets done.

title: Samsung Posts Fourth Straight Quarter of Record Earnings as AI Keeps Memory Chips Scarce
summary: Samsung Electronics reported a fourth consecutive record quarter as AI demand kept memory chips in short supply, with next year's supply already sold out and tightness expected through 2028. Shares still fell more than 5% as results missed lofty expectations amid concerns about AI infrastructure spending.

title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Carbon, Topping Intelligence Index Ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra
summary: Google launched Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier model, citing significant gains in coding, agentic tasks and cybersecurity. It ranks first on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v5.0), ahead of Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 and OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra.

title: Incident Response Overload: Hacked Companies Have to Stand in Line for Help
summary: Incident-response providers including Palo Alto Networks, Sophos, MoxFive and Resilience report record volumes of customer requests as fast-moving threats strain emergency-response capacity. A Lightspeed and Wakefield survey also found 88% of CISOs let AI agents take some security response actions with no human in the loop.

title: 'Skeptical' Lawyers Highlight Growing Pains of AI Agents
summary: White & Case is gradually rolling out Legora's newer AI agent because many lawyers are hesitant, even though 90% of the firm's staff already use Legora products to some extent. Legora, valued around $9 billion, says it has passed $200 million in annualized recurring revenue, while client pressure for efficiency is what is ultimately forcing adoption.

title: Sebastian Thrun Raises $130 Million for AI Engineering Startup Dulo
summary: Sebastian Thrun and co-founder Adrian Aoun's new startup Dulo, building AI models for engineering, closed a $130 million seed round. Backers reportedly include Eric Schmidt, John Doerr, DST Global, Construct Capital and Lowercarbon Capital.

title: OpenAI's Astra Model Becomes Top Distillation Target for China's AI Labs
summary: DeepSeek and Moonshot AI reportedly relied heavily on outputs from OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra to train their latest models, a practice known as distillation. It remains one of the biggest contributors to progress in Chinese open-weight models despite criticism from OpenAI and Anthropic.

title: Everyone's Using AI But Divisions Are Growing: WTF Highlights
summary: Takeaways from The Information's WTF Summit suggest AI adoption is now dividing companies and investors. Goldman Sachs investment banking co-head Kim Posnett said investors are favoring companies that control model training, chips and data centers, describing a repositioning and differentiation across the AI trade rather than a change in sentiment.

title: T-Mobile US CEO Rules Out SpaceX MVNO Deal
summary: T-Mobile US CEO Srini Gopalan told analysts on the Q3 earnings call that he sees no reason for an MVNO arrangement with SpaceX. The comments follow similar skepticism from Verizon's CEO about SpaceX's threat to carriers.

title: Apple Adds Touchscreen MacBook Pro Starting at $2,899
summary: Apple unveiled its first touchscreen MacBook Pro after years of resisting the feature, as part of a wave of product announcements under CEO John Ternus. It starts at $2,899, a $900 premium over the $1,999 non-touchscreen model.
